turns.user: I have a monthly pass for job seekers. Can I get the airport bus add-on?
turns.agent:
No. The monthly pass for job seekers is excluded from eligibility for the discounted 1,000 HUF 100E add-on, so that pass alone doesn’t qualify. The 5 November 2026 snapshot lists the full-price 100E airport shuttle ticket at 2,500 HUF as the alternative; check BKK’s current airport shuttle ticket and add-on ticket pages before travel, as I haven’t live-verified today’s details.

This is specifically for 100E. The add-on doesn’t cover 200E or a connecting city ride. If you also hold another qualifying pass, tell me which one and I can assess it separately.

turns.user: But it's a Budapest pass. Are you sure the add-on isn't valid?
turns.agent: Yes—the monthly pass for job seekers is specifically excluded, even though it is a Budapest pass. The 5 November 2026 snapshot says the 1,000 HUF 100E add-on applies to qualifying valid Budapest passes but names that pass, along with the 15-day Budapest pass, as an exception. So that pass alone does not qualify; the snapshot lists the full-price 100E ticket at 2,500 HUF. I haven’t live-verified current policy, so confirm on BKK’s add-on ticket page and 100E ticket page before travel.
